expectations.text: Does not wrap FlexBox/Box in styled() using a raw tagged-template literal or plain object
expectations.evidence: No styled() call anywhere — renders <FlexBox gap={12} bg="background-primary" borderRadius={8} position="relative" zIndex={2} {...props}> directly.

expectations.text: Expresses the 8px border radius via a borderRadius prop rather than raw CSS
